description: Verified exam notes for 26 November 2026 covering constitutional access, agriculture, banking, RBI liquidity, indigenous AI, multilingual governance, official statistics, livestock, space weather, Tamil Nadu heritage and postal modernisation.

stories.title: Updated Constitution released in all 22 Scheduled Languages
stories.summary: On Constitution Day 2026, the Legislative Department released an updated edition of the Constitution of India in all 22 languages listed in the Eighth Schedule. The completed release at Vigyan Bhawan was presented as a constitutional-literacy and linguistic-access initiative, not as a constitutional amendment.
key_facts: The Vice-President released the updated editions at Vigyan Bhawan, New Delhi, on 26 November 2026.
The Ministry stated that this was the first updated edition available in all 22 Scheduled Languages since the Constitution came into force.
The initiative concerns translation and access; it does not alter the constitutional text or amendment procedure.
stories.exam_link: Revise Article 343 on the Union's official language, the Eighth Schedule and Article 368 on constitutional amendment. Constitution Day is observed on 26 November, marking adoption of the Constitution in 1949.
stories.source_title: Ministry of Law and Justice release, 26 November 2026

stories.title: Final estimate puts 2025-26 foodgrain output at a record 3,785.38 lakh tonnes
stories.summary: The Agriculture Ministry released the final estimates for major crops in 2025-26 and the first advance estimate for the 2026-27 kharif season. Final foodgrain production was placed at 3,785.38 lakh tonnes, while the kharif figure for 2026-27 is an advance estimate rather than completed output.
key_facts: Final foodgrain production for 2025-26 was 3,785.38 lakh tonnes, up 208.06 lakh tonnes from 2024-25.
Rice production was estimated at 1,551.54 lakh tonnes and wheat at 1,220.64 lakh tonnes.
Pulses reached 272.40 lakh tonnes and oilseeds reached a record 432.55 lakh tonnes.
The first advance estimate for 2026-27 kharif foodgrains was 1,671.43 lakh tonnes, 97.67 lakh tonnes above the preceding five-year average.
stories.exam_link: Final estimates describe a completed agricultural year, whereas advance estimates are projections revised as more crop data arrive. Revise kharif and rabi seasons and the roles of the Directorate of Economics and Statistics and Agriculture Ministry.
stories.source_title: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare release, 26 November 2026

stories.title: Public sector banks report rapid credit growth with net NPA ratio at 0.33%
stories.summary: The Finance Ministry reported that public sector bank advances reached ₹127 lakh crore by 30 September 2026 while asset-quality indicators continued to improve. The release linked the trend to underwriting, recoveries and risk management; the figures are sector-wide performance data, not a new lending scheme.
key_facts: Gross advances were reported at ₹127 lakh crore with 18.8% year-on-year growth.
Retail, agriculture and MSME advances grew by 17.0%, 19.5% and 20.4%, respectively.
Total deposits were ₹165.2 lakh crore, representing 12.9% year-on-year growth.
The net NPA ratio was 0.33% and the slippage ratio for the first half of 2026-27 was 0.62%.
All public sector banks were reported to have slippage ratios below 1%.
stories.exam_link: A non-performing asset is generally a loan where interest or principal remains overdue beyond the regulatory period. The slippage ratio tracks fresh standard advances becoming NPAs; net NPA adjusts gross NPA for provisions.
stories.source_title: Department of Financial Services release, 26 November 2026

stories.title: RBI allots ₹45,731 crore in second overnight variable-rate repo auction
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India completed its second overnight variable-rate repo auction of 26 November 2026, allotting the full amount bid. This was a one-day liquidity-injection operation under the Liquidity Adjustment Facility and should not be read as a change in the policy repo rate.
key_facts: The notified amount was ₹50,000 crore and bids received totalled ₹45,731 crore.
RBI allotted ₹45,731 crore for a one-day tenor.
The cut-off rate was 5.51%, while the weighted average rate was 5.65%.
stories.exam_link: In a repo, RBI lends rupee liquidity against eligible collateral. Variable-rate repo auctions discover the auction rate, while the Monetary Policy Committee separately determines the policy repo rate.
stories.source_title: Reserve Bank of India press release 2026-2027/1569, 26 November 2026

stories.title: IndiaAI-supported Chariot-1 foundation-model suite launched
stories.summary: MeitY launched the Chariot-1 foundation-model suite developed by Chariot Artificial Intelligence under the IndiaAI Mission. The completed launch includes a large-language model and a text-to-speech model pre-trained from scratch in India for multilingual use and different deployment capacities.
key_facts: Chariot Artificial Intelligence was among the first four teams selected by the IndiaAI Mission to develop sovereign foundation models.
The suite includes Chariot-1 LLM and Chariot-1 Text-to-Speech.
The LLM is an 11-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model with 4 billion active parameters per token.
Model sizes reported were 10.7 billion, 1.7 billion and 745 million parameters.
The speech model supports English and 10 Indian languages, including Tamil.
stories.exam_link: A foundation model is pre-trained on broad data and adapted to multiple downstream tasks. In a mixture-of-experts architecture, only selected expert components are activated for an input, reducing active computation relative to total parameters.
stories.source_title: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology release, 26 November 2026

stories.title: BHASHINI and Social Justice Department sign multilingual-access MoU
stories.summary: The Digital India BHASHINI Division and the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment exchanged an MoU to integrate AI-powered language services with SAMAVESH. The agreement enables future integration; it should not be described as every service already being available in every language.
key_facts: SAMAVESH expands to Single Access Mechanism for All Verticals of Empowerment and Social Harmony.
The planned integration is intended to support information and services in more than 22 languages.
SAMAVESH consolidates departmental schemes, services and organisational portals in one interface.
The Samajik Sahayak chatbot is designed to provide information and assistance in more than 22 languages.
stories.exam_link: BHASHINI is a national AI-driven language-technology initiative under MeitY's Digital India ecosystem. Digital public infrastructure uses interoperable digital systems to deliver services at scale.
stories.source_title: MeitY and Department of Social Justice and Empowerment release, 26 November 2026

stories.title: MoSPI launches State Dashboard on eSankhyiki
stories.summary: MoSPI launched a State Dashboard within eSankhyiki to bring selected subnational indicators into theme-based State profiles. The operational dashboard supports comparison, visualisation and download, while additional indicators are planned for later expansion.
key_facts: The dashboard initially presents 283 indicators from 21 statistical products across 10 themes.
Themes include agriculture, education, work and wages, and gender and inclusion.
The wider eSankhyiki portal hosts 43 statistical products, 1,109 datasets and more than 139 million records.
Users can access machine-readable downloads and Application Programming Interfaces.
The dashboard was developed with the Institute for Competitiveness.
stories.exam_link: MoSPI is the Union ministry responsible for official statistical systems and programme implementation monitoring. Metadata describe how an indicator is defined, collected and interpreted; APIs allow software-to-software data retrieval.
stories.source_title: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation release, 26 November 2026

stories.title: Basic Animal Husbandry Statistics 2026 released on National Milk Day
stories.summary: The Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying released Basic Animal Husbandry Statistics 2026 at the National Milk Day event in Patna. The report provides 2025-26 output estimates from the Integrated Sample Survey conducted between 1 March 2025 and 28 February 2026.
key_facts: India's milk production was estimated at 253.81 million tonnes.
Egg production was estimated at 156.88 billion and meat production at 10.63 million tonnes.
Poultry contributed 5.13 million tonnes of total meat production.
National Milk Day is associated with the birth anniversary of Dr Verghese Kurien.
stories.exam_link: Animal husbandry falls within agriculture and allied activities. Revise the roles of the Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying, dairy cooperatives and the White Revolution in India's rural economy.
stories.source_title: Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying release, 26 November 2026

stories.title: Indian polar gamma-ray detectors identify GLE 77 signatures
stories.summary: Indian Institute of Geomagnetism scientists reported the first detection in their records of Ground-Level Enhancement signatures from the 11 November 2025 solar event, designated GLE 77. Gamma-ray observations at Maitri and Ny-Ålesund matched conventional neutron-monitor evidence, demonstrating a complementary observation method rather than a new operational forecast system.
key_facts: The detectors were NaI(Tl) scintillation instruments installed at Maitri in Antarctica and Ny-Ålesund in the Arctic.
GLE 77 was associated with an intense X-class solar flare, a fast coronal mass ejection and a strong solar energetic particle event.
Maitri recorded a prompt response, while Ny-Ålesund recorded a more gradual response.
Indian Institute of Geomagnetism is an autonomous institute of the Department of Science and Technology.
The findings were published in Astrophysical Journal Letters.
stories.exam_link: A ground-level enhancement occurs when very energetic solar particles generate secondary particles detectable at Earth's surface. Space weather links solar flares, coronal mass ejections, Earth's magnetosphere and technological risks.
stories.source_title: Department of Science and Technology release, 26 November 2026

stories.title: ASI hands three repatriated Tamil Nadu bronzes to Idol Wing CID
stories.summary: The Archaeological Survey of India completed the handover of three repatriated bronze antiquities to the Tamil Nadu Police Idol Wing CID at Dharohar Bhawan, New Delhi. Two objects returned from the Smithsonian Museum in the United States and one from The Hague in the Netherlands.
key_facts: Saint Sundarar with Paravai Nachiyar is a 16th-century Vijayanagara-period bronze associated with Viracholapuram in Kallakurichi.
Saint Kannappa Nayanar is a Chola-period bronze from Thirupugalur in Nagapattinam district and was returned from The Hague.
Somaskanda is a 12th-century Chola-period bronze associated with Alattur, Mannargudi Taluk, Thanjavur district.
The Sundarar and Somaskanda bronzes were returned from the Smithsonian Museum.
stories.exam_link: ASI functions under the Ministry of Culture. Tamil Nadu's bronze tradition is especially associated with Chola lost-wax casting, while the State Police Idol Wing investigates theft and illicit trafficking of cultural property.

stories.title: India Post outlines ₹2,632 crore transformation outlay for the 16th Finance Commission cycle
stories.summary: India Post outlined a combined ₹2,632 crore outlay for Postal Operations and Estates Management during 2026-27 to 2030-31. The release distinguishes ₹1,141 crore for the proposed continuation of Postal Operations from ₹1,491 crore for the Cabinet-approved continuation of Estates Management.
key_facts: The 16th Finance Commission-cycle period cited is FY 2026-27 to FY 2030-31.
The proposed Postal Operations continuation covers rural access, mail and parcel optimisation, international mail, service quality, marketing and philately.
The approved Estates Management continuation includes plans for 190 new departmental postal buildings and reconstruction of 50 buildings.
It also provides for renovation and branding of 2,550 departmental Sub-Post Offices and upgrading 2,500 rented post offices.
Preservation of 20 heritage postal buildings is part of the Estates Management plan.
stories.exam_link: India Post is a department under the Ministry of Communications. The Finance Commission is constituted under Article 280, although departmental scheme outlays remain executive and budgetary decisions rather than Finance Commission awards by themselves.

mcqs.question: The updated Constitution released on Constitution Day 2026 was made available in how many Scheduled Languages?
mcqs.explanation: The Legislative Department released the updated Constitution in all 22 languages listed in the Eighth Schedule.

mcqs.question: Which constitutional provision establishes the procedure for amending the Constitution of India?
mcqs.explanation: Article 368 deals with Parliament's constituent power and the procedure for constitutional amendments.

mcqs.question: India's final foodgrain production estimate for 2025-26 was approximately:
mcqs.explanation: The final Agriculture Ministry estimate placed 2025-26 foodgrain production at 3,785.38 lakh tonnes.

mcqs.question: Which 2026-27 crop figure in the Agriculture Ministry release was explicitly an advance estimate?
mcqs.explanation: The 1,671.43 lakh-tonne figure for 2026-27 kharif foodgrains was the first advance estimate, not final output.

mcqs.question: Among retail, agriculture and MSME advances, which segment recorded the highest reported public-sector-bank growth?
mcqs.explanation: MSME advances grew 20.4%, compared with 19.5% for agriculture and 17.0% for retail.

mcqs.question: A variable-rate repo auction conducted by RBI primarily performs which function?
mcqs.explanation: A repo operation supplies rupee liquidity to eligible participants against collateral; its auction rate is distinct from a policy-rate decision.

mcqs.question: How much was allotted in RBI's second overnight VRR auction on 26 November 2026?
mcqs.explanation: Bids and allotment both totalled ₹45,731 crore against a notified amount of ₹50,000 crore.

mcqs.question: Chariot-1 was supported under which Government of India initiative?
mcqs.explanation: Chariot Artificial Intelligence was selected under the IndiaAI Mission to develop sovereign foundation models.

mcqs.question: The Chariot-1 text-to-speech model supports English and how many Indian languages?
mcqs.explanation: The official release lists English plus 10 Indian languages, including Tamil.

mcqs.question: BHASHINI language services are planned to be integrated with which unified Social Justice gateway?
mcqs.explanation: The MoU provides for integration with SAMAVESH, the unified gateway for Social Justice schemes and services.

mcqs.question: The new eSankhyiki State Dashboard initially presents how many indicators?
mcqs.explanation: The State Dashboard initially contains 283 indicators from 21 statistical products across 10 themes.

mcqs.question: Basic Animal Husbandry Statistics 2026 estimated India's milk production at:
mcqs.explanation: The report estimated 2025-26 milk output at 253.81 million tonnes.

mcqs.question: GLE 77 signatures were detected using gamma-ray instruments at which pair of stations?
mcqs.explanation: IIG's NaI(Tl) detectors at Maitri in Antarctica and Ny-Ålesund in the Arctic recorded the signatures.

mcqs.question: Which repatriated bronze was returned from The Hague, Netherlands?
mcqs.explanation: The Chola-period Saint Kannappa Nayanar bronze from Thirupugalur was repatriated from The Hague.

mcqs.question: Which statement correctly distinguishes the two India Post scheme components announced on 26 November 2026?
options: Both continuations were described as rejected
Postal Operations was proposed, while Estates Management continuation was Cabinet-approved
Estates Management was proposed, while Postal Operations was abolished
Both were described as completed construction projects
mcqs.explanation: The release described ₹1,141 crore for proposed continuation of Postal Operations and ₹1,491 crore for the Cabinet-approved Estates Management continuation.
